note: 공방 공통 외형 · 표정 낱말(영어 지시문 글). 원본 — 공방 lib/ 끝 「core:v3」 블록은 core/sync.cjs 가 이 파일에서 옮긴다(손으로 고치지 않는다). v2 에서 바꾼 것: VOCAB_EN.face_shape.square_soft 「softly square face」 → 「softly squared face with a rounded jaw」, face_shape.angular 「refined face with gently defined cheekbones」 → 「refined face with a clean, softly tapered outline」, lips.wide_smile 「wide smiling mouth」 → 「a wide mouth with softly upturned corners」(감사 E2 · S8 · G3 · B4 — 시험 한 쌍씩에서 그림 차이는 거의 없었고, 지시문 안의 부딪히는 말을 걷어 내는 정리. 사용자 2026-11-11 「정리하는 김에 깔끔하게 하는게 낫지?」).

age.early_20s: AGE: about twenty — a fresh young-adult face; no facial lines.
age.mid_20s: AGE: mid-twenties — a clear adult face; no facial lines.
age.late_20s: AGE: late twenties — a graceful grown-up face with soft, smooth contours; no wrinkles, folds or under-eye bags.
age.early_30s: AGE: early thirties — a poised, graceful face with soft contours; at most faint lines, no deep folds or under-eye bags.
age.late_30s: AGE: late thirties — a glamorous, alluring mature beauty in her prime: confident, sensual poise, a knowing gaze and a ripe, womanly figure; smooth, radiant skin with at most the faintest lines at the eye corners; never old, tired, gaunt or matronly — still the small, soft chin and soft contours.
